meta.frame: local metres; origin = BioCity centroid lat 60.44932, lon 22.29326; x = east, z = south (north = -z), y = up. x=(lon-22.29326)*111320*cos(60.44932 deg); z=-(lat-60.44932)*110540. Coordinates rounded to 0.1 m.
meta.threejs: Use (x, y, z) directly with +y up. A direction at angle a (deg, counter-clockwise from east toward north) is (cos a, 0, -sin a); Object3D.rotation.y = a*PI/180 turns local +x to that direction.
meta.heightRule: heightEstimate = OSM height tag if present, else (building:levels + roof:levels) x 3.6 m; minHeight = min_height tag, else building:min_level x 3.6 m. Compare with cityModel (Turku CityGML LOD2 measured roofs) where present - prefer measured values.
meta.polygonConvention: polygon rings are NOT closed (last point != first); vertex order as in OSM (either winding).
meta.bboxCoverage: x -206..+370, z -241..+312 (OSM API returns complete ways crossing the bbox edge).

meta.routing: Dijkstra on OSM walkable ways (footway/path/pedestrian/steps/cycleway with foot!=no, service, unclassified/residential with x2 cost, service x1.3 unless foot=designated). Pedestrian areas get straight visibility edges between junction nodes. Indoor corridors excluded unless mode=indoor-allowed. Non-network endpoints joined by straight access segments (reported). Times at 1.3 m/s, no extra time for steps.

mainVolume.mainRoofHeight_m: ~31 above Tykistökatu kerb (54.0-23.1); parapet/plant up to 57.0 N2000 (~34 m)
mainVolume.secondaryRoofs: roof areas at 49-50 m N2000 (~26-27 m) over parts of the SW/SE wing; glass lobby skylight runs from the main entrance to the Joki link (ortho)
mainVolume.groundFloorRecess: arcade: upper floors overhang ~3.0 m along the Tykistökatu facade (part w580071163) and ~2.5 m along Lemminkäisenkatu (parts w1328195307, w1328195308); glass west corner overhangs an open ground floor (part w1328195311); OSM min_level=1 -> clear height ~4.4 m (estimate from LOD2 storey height ~4.4 m)

BioCity.orientation: long facades at 124.7 deg CCW from east (= -55.3 deg; long axis bearing 145.3/325.3 deg, NW-SE, parallel to Lemminkäisenkatu); short/cross facades 34.6 deg; the Tykistökatu (NW) facade is skewed at 58.6 deg (parallel to Tykistökatu). three.js rotation.y = -0.965 rad aligns local +x with the long axis (pointing SSE).
BioCity.extent: OBB 91.9 m (along 124.7 deg) x 65.4 m incl. NE wing; main tall volume ~92 x 50 m
BioCity.facades: NW (Tykistökatu) facade line (-40.6,-5.4)->(-12.7,-51.1), 53.5 m, with entrance notch; SW (Lemminkäisenkatu) facade (-40.6,-5.4)->(-0.9,51.9), 69.7 m, arcade; NE facade of tall volume (-12.7,-51.1)->(39.5,24.3), 91.6 m, fronted by the 1-storey NE wing; SE end joins Joki between (17.5,39.9) and (32.0,29.5)
BioCity.heights: tall volume main roof 54.0 m N2000 (~31 m above street 23.1), plant to 57.0; NE wing roof 28.3-28.6 (~5.4 m); OSM rule estimate 25.2 m underestimates
BioCity.colour: OSM building:colour #303030 (dark grey concrete panels); glass west corner; photo: glass curtain-wall corner with SCIENCE PARK / WORLD TRADE CENTER rooftop signs

entrances.toJoki_internal: SE end of main lobby (TTK plan)

Tykistokatu.relation: runs along BioCity's NW facade at 57.7 deg CCW from east (bearing ~32 deg, SSW->NNE), from the signalised junction with Itäinen Pitkäkatu/Lemminkäisenkatu at (-52.3,-9.6) (28 m W of the main entrance) to the Kupittaa railway bridge (Kupittaansilta) ~200 m NE
Tykistokatu.lanes: OSM lanes=4 (2+2), width=15 along BioCity/Electrocity (w924357700/1, turn:lanes forward left|through;right at the junction); lanes=6 width=23 at Eurocity (w4068497, 4 backward incl. left|through|through|right); dual carriageway (2 + 4 lanes) at the bridge
Tykistokatu.widthDiscrepancy: OSM width=15/lanes=4 vs 10.0-12.8 m kerb-to-kerb (Turku kantakartta). Light-traffic way on the BioCity side spans ~0.7-6 m behind the kerb (kantakartta edges). Lane count near Electrocity possibly 3 - unverified.
Tykistokatu.kerbOffset: OSM centreline sits 2.8-6.4 m from the SE (BioCity-side) kerb and ~7.2 m from the NW kerb -> centreline is not centred; use kantakartta kerb lines (turkuBaseMap.kerbLines) for the carriageway polygon
Tykistokatu.sides: BioCity side: segregated cycleway+footway w145575828 (2 m cycle, paving-stone footway) in a 4.6 m strip between kerb and facade line, plus 3 m arcade under the overhang; NW side: cycleway w778846613, Dentalia lawn with trees

JussinAukio.connections: NW: passage between BioCity NE wing and Electrocity (footway w625297918, 5.6-11.5 m wide) to Tykistökatu; N/NE: footway w186335874 to Eurocity S door n1970088681 (65.4,-27.0) and strip between Electrocity and ICT-City (cycleway w625297914) to Joukahaisenkatu; E: steps w625297907 up 1.6 m to the deck (25.30) -> EduCity; S: Joki tower door n5904154003 and steps w845422812 down to Joki N door n7887550473

syvanneCandidates.terrainNote: No terrain depression exists beside BioCity on Tykistökatu: Turku spot heights 23.12-23.27 m at the junction, 23.15 m at the notch, 23.37 m in the passage, 23.59 m on Tykistökatu at Electrocity, 23.71 m Jussin aukio. "Syvänne" must mean a recess in plan.

candidates.name: Paved pocket between BioCity (N corner + curved auditorium) and Electrocity, open to Tykistökatu
candidates.dimensions: mouth 24.5 m wide on the building line (BioCity N corner (-12.6,-51.1) to Electrocity W corner (0.4,-71.8)); 28.7 m deep to the auditorium apex (9.8,-32.9); narrows to 11.5 m at the apex and 5.6 m further in (auditorium NE corner (25.8,-24.4) to Electrocity facade) before reaching Jussin aukio ~90 m from the street
candidates.surface: pavers at the mouth, dark asphalt passage further in (OSM footway w625297918 surface=asphalt; 2022 ortho)
candidates.currentUse: waste/recycling containers and small sheds at about (0..10, -49..-34) (ortho + kantakartta rectangles); lamp posts; Electrocity entrance n5580536374 (3.4,-67.3) and Electrocity side stairs; bicycle stands deeper in (w1212594802 around (30,-28))
candidates.level: flat: spot 23.37 m N2000 at (11.9,-42.8) vs Tykistökatu 23.15-23.59 -> no dip
candidates.streetAccess: nearest kerb point on Tykistökatu SE kerb (kantakartta) (-11.4,-63.7); a segregated cycleway+footway (OSM w145575828) runs between kerb and pocket; no mapped driveway/dropped kerb (unverified)
candidates.fitForCars: room for 3-5 cars (G-Wagon 4.87 x 1.98 m) with walk-around space if containers are moved; visible from Tykistökatu
candidates.why: the only recess on BioCity's Tykistökatu side large enough for "a few supercars" and directly beside the road; 30-50 m walk from the BioCity main entrance (route d2 64.9 m from the passage kerb)

candidates.name: Recessed forecourt of the BioCity main entrance (notch in the Tykistökatu facade) incl. the open ground floor under the glass corner
candidates.dimensions: notch mouth 14.4 m on the facade line (-35.6,-13.6)-(-28.0,-25.8), ~9.5 m deep to the door line (-28.3,-8.8)-(-20.0,-14.3); door (revolving/sliding) n11432405620 at (-24.6,-11.3); spans full building height with a glass frame bridging the top (photo + ortho)
candidates.level: spot 23.15 m N2000 at (-39.0,-12.1) - level with the street; no dip
candidates.streetAccess: kerb point (-35.6,-22.0) is 15.7 m walking from the door (route d); signalised zebra w48381053 lands at (-38.6,-13.0) right at the west corner
candidates.fitForCars: ~95 m2 open-sky + ~80 m2 covered corner arcade; 1-2 cars without blocking the entrance path
candidates.why: literal "syvennys" (recess) beside Tykistökatu where the companies enter; but it is the entrance path itself

syvanneCandidates.owner_quote: In front of BioCity runs the biggest road, Tykistökatu... By the road, in the recess/dip (syvänne) next to BioCity, we will have a few supercars (4 Oct 2026)

claimCheck.claim: EduCity -> BioCity & Joki: approx. 50 m outdoors (organiser estimate)
claimCheck.verdict: Not true for any outdoor walk. Shortest outdoor walks: EduCity deck door -> Joki tower door 150.7 m (~1.9 min, step-free on the deck); EduCity deck door -> BioCity courtyard entrance 201.4 m (~2.6 min, ~10 steps down from the deck + terrace steps at BioCity). Building gaps: EduCity-BioCity 153.9 m wall-to-wall, EduCity-Joki 124.4 m; 6-storey ICT-City (133 m long) stands between them.
claimCheck.whatCouldBeTrue: About 30-80 m outdoors only if people first walk ~130-140 m INDOORS through ICT-City (EduCity skybridge -> ICT-City corridors -> ICT-City NW doors at Jussin aukio): ICT-City NW door -> Joki tower door 33.2 m, -> BioCity courtyard entrance 77.8 m. Requires ICT-City to be open/unlocked on 6-8 Nov 2026 (Fri-Sun; ICT-City main doors are weekday 07:30-18:30 per TUAS) - unverified.
claimCheck.suggestedWording: approx. 150 m outdoors (2 min) to Joki, approx. 200 m (3 min) to BioCity's courtyard entrance, across the raised campus deck and Jussin aukio
